meta.note: Committed fallback snapshot. Every value below was pulled live from the Eurostat dissemination API (statistics/1.0/data/<dataset>?format=JSON) and computed directly with jq — not read off a rendered page. js/observatory.js tries a live fetch first and falls back to this file on any network/CORS failure, so the section never renders empty. Regenerate with scripts/fetch-eurostat.sh.
